changes: Created and refined Lattice-Engineering-Baseline-Unlock-Execution-Plan.md as the formal Layer 2 Engineering Baseline unlock execution plan. The document defines Layer 2 scope, lower-layer preconditions, proof contract, host and agent layout, execution runbook, per-baseline requirements, fail-closed rules, pass criteria, stop conditions, milestones, and final unlock decisions.
usage: Use Lattice-Engineering-Baseline-Unlock-Execution-Plan.md before formal Layer 2 unlock work. Follow its preflight, execute ENG-* baselines, aggregate suite evidence, then authorize only the Engineering Baseline claim when all gates pass.
expectedOutcome: The user should see a concrete executable document for formally unlocking Layer 2 Engineering Baseline without overclaiming unattended development, production safety, or capability claims from Layer 2 proof alone.
actualTranscript: Executed npm run build, lattice story_advance to TEST, and lattice validate --story=B-2949. TEST preflight passed channel, concept, lint, and docs-drift gates. lattice validate passed npm test and reported verification intent coverage 9/9 covered with 0 required missing.
outcomeDiff: No material difference: the document exists, review issues were fixed, TEST preflight passed, and validate confirmed all checklist verification intents are covered.
limitations: Layer 2 is documented as an unlock execution plan only. It does not claim Layer 3 Loop Engineering, Layer 4 Production Safety, or Layer 5 Capability Claim are unlocked.
pitfalls: TEST initially failed because packages/main/dist was absent in the fresh worktree, causing packages/utils TypeScript imports from main/dist to fail. Running npm run build generated the required dist output and the lint gate then passed.
